title.narrative: Stöd till WFP/UNHAS i Burkina Faso 2023

description.narrative:
Insatsen syftar till att tillhandahålla säker, pålitlig och effektiv flygtjänst till humanitära- och utvecklingspartner i Burkina Faso. FN:s humanitära flygtjänst är tillgänglig för humanitära så väl som utvecklingsaktörer, därigenom möjliggörs tillträde i svåråtkomliga kontexter för genomförande, uppföljning och frakt av livsviktiga insatsvaror. Detta för att stödja ett effektivt humanitärt stöd och utvecklingsbistånd, samt möjliggöra framkomlighet till befolkningar i svåråtkomliga områden.
Syftet är att individer i behov ska kunna få få snabb och effektivt stöd, genom de tjänster och transport som tillhandahålls för humanitära partners och utvecklingsaktörer.

The contribution aim to provide safe, reliable and efficient air service to the humanitarian and development community in Burkina Faso. The UN's humanitarian air service is available to humanitarian as well as development actors, thereby enabling access in hard-to-reach contexts for implementation, follow-up and shipping of vital supplies. This in order to support effective and efficient humanitarian and development assistance and enable access to populations in to hard to reach areas.
The aim is that crises-affected communities will benefit from services and transportation provided to humanitarian and development partners, receiving timely and effective assistance.

The intervention will contribute to outcome objective of WFP's Strategic Outcome 6, of WFP Country Strategy Plan in Burkina 2018-2023: Humanitarian and Development partners benefit from common services that enable them to reach and operate in targeted areas all year.
The intervention will particularly support activity 9: Provide logistics support to partners as needed.
The specific objective of the intervention is therefore to: Provide safe, reliable and efficient air service (cargo and passenger support) to the humanitarian and development community in Burkina Faso, including NGOs, UN agencies, donor organizations and diplomatic missions. This in order to support effective and efficient humanitarian and development assistance and enable access to populations in to hard to reach areas.

2.1 - By 2030, end hunger and ensure access by all people, in particular the poor and people in vulnerable situations, including infants, to safe, nutritious and sufficient food all year round.
